name: coea
description: Coea is the back office of nonprofit organizations: contacts, donations, tax receipts, events, campaigns and newsletters. This plugin lets a staff member run that back office from ChatGPT, with the permissions of their own Coea role.

interface.longDescription:
Coea is an all-in-one platform for nonprofits: a contact database, donations with tax receipts, events with registration, fundraising campaigns, newsletters and a public website. Connect your Coea account to ask ChatGPT about your organization and keep it up to date in plain language.

What you can do:
- Find contacts by name, email or tag, add a new contact, add a note or an important date.
- See donations and totals, list gifts that still need a thank-you, record a gift received by cheque, bank transfer or cash.
- List upcoming events and who registered, create an event, cancel a registration (without refund).
- Review campaigns and dashboard figures, draft a newsletter.

Every action uses the permissions of your role in Coea and is written to your organization's audit log. Changes are confirmed before they are saved. This version does not move money: it never charges a card, never issues a refund and never changes your Coea subscription. Those stay in the Coea administration.

The interface and data are available in French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Hebrew.
capabilities: Review donations and record offline gifts

positive.prompt: Who are the volunteers of Les Jardins du Fleuve? Give me their names and emails.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the contacts tagged "benevole" (Camille Tremblay, Sophie Roy, Olivier Morin, Marie Pelletier) with their emails, and nothing is modified.

positive.prompt: How much did we receive in donations since July 1st, and from whom?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the donations dated after 2026-07-01 with donor, amount and date, and gives the total. Read only.

positive.prompt: Add a new contact: Gabriel Ouellet, gabriel.ouellet@example.org, phone 514 555 0199.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then creates the contact and returns its name and email. A second identical request is refused because the email already exists.

positive.prompt: Record a $40 cheque donation from Léa Lavoie, dated today, cheque number 1042.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Léa Lavoie, asks for confirmation, then records a $40.00 cheque donation with reference 1042. No payment is charged.

positive.prompt: What events are coming up, and who registered for the harvest dinner?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three upcoming events (fall work day, harvest dinner, winter seeding workshop) with dates, then the registrations of the harvest dinner, or says there are none yet.

negative.description: Refund request (money movement is out of scope)

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It records gifts that the organization already received outside ChatGPT (cheque, bank transfer, cash) for bookkeeping, and never charges, refunds or transfers money.
